commits.body:

The breakpoint requires the target, prescribed caller and observer on the same thread stack on every repetition. An unrelated earlier call cannot qualify. Supply original provider registrations, record elapsed time on open cases, bind additional caller sources, and retain the original release tags and declared public Maven repositories for historical builds.

The new side failed on the missing ErrorCoded class before reaching that callback. A separate bounded probe classified a real FTP file, directory and missing path on both Commons Net versions. All 28 affected test groups passed, including positive and dormant-wrapper controls. Validated 29 scopes with 11 original fixture bindings and six runtime companion declarations.
